introduction: Help the witch gather useful beetle parts, choose among four potion crafts, and combine the red potion with an ancient signet and dragon scale for the ring ritual. Follow the expedition books as clues while keeping actual ingredients, accepted outcomes and the heartstone refusal distinct.
orientation: Go DOWN from the Khomani-Khan surface depression to the cliff landing, then follow the zigzag path down into the basin. The landing’s UP exit returns to the surface. Old city/Nizari prose is a clue mismatch: the actual boundary is to the surface. The witch and the elixir-bearing minotaur start at the basin entrance.

Ask witch greetings or welcome for the helpful opening, then help, search, components, ring or signet. Hello, hi and howdy receive a different response. The six response families have fourteen aliases; each keyword reveals a response, not another quest achievement.

The witch makes four distinct potions from a dark-magic elixir plus one exact beetle part. The elixir starts hidden on one minotaur lizard beside her. Give the elixir to choose crafting while carrying only the intended part kind loose: gland makes red, mandible brown, shell white and horn spotted white. Giving a part chooses its cash sale even if you also carry the elixir.

The four part sales pay the same native 25,000 coin amount and form one journal outcome. Any one exact shell, mandible, gland or horn fits. Each sold copy is consumed and cannot also be used for a potion. A minotaur or beetle name alone does not guarantee that reset instance carries its component.

The ring ritual needs the exact glowing red potion, ancient signet and smoldering scale together. Sakaslan carries the hidden scale in the swamp; Aberden’s fixed corpse holds the signet. The red potion is the gland craft reward. Matching supplied ingredients need no personal earlier craft, mage kill, dragon kill or expedition reading history.

Six fixed corpse containers hold the distinct expedition books: Michith near the oasis description, Cyril by the western wall, Tomak in the swamp, Gordas on the wastes, Aberden in the swamp and Milton at the cave dead end. They start open, not locked. SEARCH the named container to reveal hidden contents, recover the book and READ its descriptions. Reading reveals native prose but currently records no durable learned-clue milestone.

Milton’s partially ruined book includes separate passage1, passage2 and passage3 descriptions. These explain the doomed search for the Crystal City. The cave’s final room explicitly has no door or portal onward. Its spider blocks EAST, the only ordinary way back; neither the journal nor lore creates a new exit or removes the blocker.

The pool’s actual fixed water source is in a wastes room, separate from the room titled Oasis that holds Michith’s corpse. The pool attracts many vermin, but its fire beetle has no gland reset. Ordinary water, combat, staff use, potion drinking, armor and diary reading are supporting activities, not additional accepted quest outcomes.

Sakaslan’s heartstone, imported black skull and smoldering scale are three distinct prototypes. The witch refuses the heartstone through a same-kind replacement recipe, with no achievement or daily. Do not offer it for the ring or assume the original object identity, custody or enhancements survive that exchange.

Current loose inputs, earlier accepted receipts, source recovery, gifts, reading, access, combat and actual rewards remain separate. An old potion receipt cannot restore a consumed elixir or potion. The cap-one elixir/signature sources and live reset/accounting admission still govern availability; static daily candidates do not prove renewable supply.

Discovery has its own achievement; meeting the witch reveals the seven cards. All new discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit requires active, ready accounting, with frozen reward recovery separate. No native recipe, reset, blocker, item flags, portal or PvP mobility change is enabled here.

contacts.name: an old witch
contacts.description: Starts at the basin entrance with a wooden staff. Ask the listed topics; greetings and welcome get a helpful response. Crafts four distinct potions, performs the signet ritual, buys any one beetle part, and refuses the heartstone. She also has the shared teacher flag; teaching is a separate service.

contacts.name: a minotaur lizard
contacts.description: One minotaur lizard at the witch’s starting room carries the hidden dark-magic elixir. Other minotaur resets do not supply it. The cap-one source and competing crafts make fresh availability important.

contacts.name: Sakaslan, the destroyer
contacts.description: Starts in the swamp carrying a hidden smoldering scale and imported black skull, while holding the heartstone. Only the exact scale enters the signet ritual. A supplied scale does not prove a personal dragon kill.

contacts.name: a bombardier beetle
contacts.description: The bombardier beetles start wearing the exact shell. It can feed either the milky white potion or the shared cash payment; each consumed copy has one use.

contacts.name: the slicer beetle
contacts.description: Equipped slicer beetles carry the exact mandible. It can feed the milky brown potion or cash payment; not every slicer at the pool has the part.

contacts.name: a fire beetle
contacts.description: Ten tunnel fire beetles start holding light glands. The fire beetle at the pool has no gland reset. The gland can feed the red potion or cash payment.

contacts.name: a rhinoceros beetle
contacts.description: Equipped rhino beetles carry the exact horn. It can feed the spotted white potion or cash payment; the pool rhino has no horn reset.

contacts.name: a wolf spider
contacts.description: Starts at Milton’s corpse at the cave dead end. The shared procedure blocks EAST, which is the only ordinary exit back toward the basin, while the spider is present for an ordinary player. The endpoint contains no Crystal City entrance.

stories.title: Witch: enchant the ancient signet
stories.summary: Bring the exact smoldering scale, glowing red potion and ancient signet together for the white-gold ring and native 500,000 XP reward. The potion can be crafted here; supplied matching proof needs no personal earlier craft or kill. The signet starts in Aberden’s fixed corpse container. Killing an unidentified mage or reaching the Crystal City is not required.

Sakaslan starts carrying this hidden scale. The heartstone and imported black skull are different items; the recipe does not require proof of your personal kill. Carry exact copies loose.
